rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately removing an attached item, such as a tag or part, from something.

example.english: This label is stuck on too firmly; I'll detach it for you.
example.traditional: 呢個標籤黐得太實，我幫你拆落嚟。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 biu1 cim1 ci1 dak1 taai3 sat6 ngo5 bong1 nei5 caak3 lok6 lei4

rows.note: Use this specifically for taking off something worn or attached to the body, such as clothing or an accessory.

example.english: It's so hot; detach your jacket.
example.traditional: 天氣咁熱，除低件外套啦。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 gam3 jit6 ceoi4 dai1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 laa1

rows.note: Use this when an attached thing has come loose or come off, especially in casual speech.

example.english: The button did detach from my shirt.
